items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: the year that I was in the contest, I was ahead of Phay Terrell and Billy Eckstein as a vocalist

ctx.x: Yeah, all the singing with his band, and it's a funny thing; that if you could see -- my son has a scrapbook -- the Pittsburgh Courier used to have contests, you know, male vocalists, drummer and trombone player. Well, the thing that I circled -- the year that I was in the contest, I was ahead of Phay Terrell and Billy Eckstein as a vocalist, so you know, in later years, after I quit fooling with singing and just started to play drums, I would look at that every once in awhile and think about, you know, if they…
that I could get more votes, you know ...
